description.zh:
续费时是否自动付费。取值：
* **True**：自动付费。请确保账号有足够的余额。
* **False**：控制台手动付费。具体操作为：登录控制台，在右上角选择**费用>进入费用中心**，在**订单管理**找到目标订单进行支付。

默认值：**False**。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-payment for renewals. Valid values:

- **True**: Auto-payment is enabled. Make sure that your account has a sufficient balance.

- False: Manual payment is required. To pay for an order, log on to the console. In the upper-right corner, choose **Billing** > **User Center**. On the **Order Management** page, find the order and complete the payment.

Default value: **False**.

description.zh: 付费类型。
description.en: The billing method of the instance. Valid values: PostPaid (pay-as-you-go) and PrePaid (subscription).

description.zh:
实例包年包月的时间，取值：

- PricingCycle为**Month**，表示按月付费，取值范围为**1**~**9**。
- PricingCycle为**Year**，表示按年付费，取值范围为**1**~**3**。

> ChargeType取值为**PrePaid**时，本参数可用且必须传入。
description.en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

- If PricingCycle is set to **Month**, the valid values are **1** to **9**.

- If PricingCycle is set to **Year**, the valid values are **1** to **3**.

> This parameter is required and takes effect only if you set ChargeType to **PrePaid**.

description.zh: HTTPS的策略
description.en: The HTTPS policy.

description.zh:
专享实例类型为VPC融合专享实例时，实例所在网段
- 192.168.0.0/16
- 172.16.0.0/12

><warning>VPC融合专享实例会连接您指定的网段，请尽量避开冲突，以防出现云产品的私网IP和您指定网段下云服务IP冲突的情况></warning>
><notice>该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用。></notice>
description.en:
The CIDR block of the instance if the instance is a VPC-connected dedicated instance.

- 192.168.0.0/16

- 172.16.0.0/12

><warning>The VPC-connected dedicated instance connects to the specified CIDR block. To prevent IP address conflicts, make sure that the CIDR block does not overlap with the private IP addresses of your Alibaba Cloud services.></warning>
><notice>This parameter is available only for invitational preview and is not publicly available.></notice>

description.zh: 实例名称
description.en: The name of the instance.

description.zh: 实例规格
description.en: The instance type.

description.zh:
专享实例类型
- vpc_connect：VPC融合类型专享实例
- normal：传统类型专享实例

><notice>该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用。></notice>
description.en:
The type of the dedicated instance.

- vpc\_connect: a VPC-connected dedicated instance

- normal: a classic network-type dedicated instance

><notice>

This parameter is available only for invitational preview and is not publicly available.

></notice>

description.zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或包月类型，取值范围如下：

- **year**：年
- **month**：月

> 若付费类型为PrePaid，该参数为必传参数。
description.en:
The billing cycle of the subscription instance. Valid values:

- **year**

- **month**

> This parameter is required if you set ChargeType to PrePaid.

description.zh: 标签列表。
description.en: A list of tags.

description.zh: 标签键
description.en: The tag key.

description.zh: 标签的值。
description.en: The tag value.

description.zh: 口令，是用来做防止重复提交请求的，请勿重复使用。如果Token字符串的前后包含空格，空格会被网关自动删除（Trim）。
description.en: A security token used to prevent duplicate requests. Do not reuse the token. The gateway automatically removes leading and trailing spaces from the token string.

description.zh:
专享实例类型为VPC融合专享实例时，需要连通的用户VPC ID
><notice>该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用。></notice>
description.en: The ID of the user VPC to which you want to connect. This parameter is required if the instance is a VPC-connected dedicated instance. ><notice>This parameter is available only for invitational preview and is not publicly available.></notice>

description.zh: 可用区，专享实例类型为传统类型专享实例为必填项，VPC融合类型专享实例可以不填
description.en: The zone where the instance is deployed. This parameter is required for classic network-type dedicated instances. This parameter is optional for VPC-connected dedicated instances.

description.zh:
专享实例类型为VPC融合专享实例时，需要连通网络所需要的可用区，虚拟交换机以及安全组信息
><notice>该参数正在邀测中，暂未开放使用。></notice>
description.en: The zone, vSwitch, and security group information required for network connectivity. This parameter is required if the instance is a VPC-connected dedicated instance. ><notice>This parameter is available only for invitational preview and is not publicly available.></notice>

description.zh: 交换机的IPv4网段。
description.en: The IPv4 CIDR block of the vSwitch.

description.zh: 安全组的ID，同一个安全组内的服务可以互相访问。
description.en: The ID of the security group. Services in the same security group can access each other.

description.zh: 虚拟交换机ID
description.en: The vSwitch ID.

description.zh: 可用区ID
description.en: The zone ID.
